694.text: "Well... almost everyone. But you have a point, Laurento. We can be proud of this agreement."

695.speaker: Elena Werner
695.text: "A respectable decision, Your Majesty. But I hope you're prepared for the fallout."

701.speaker: Elena Werner
701.text: "Our only other option is to turn down Morella's offer of a share in the nationalized MITZ. We'll certainly be in a position to keep the demands we've made in that case."

703.speaker: Elena Werner
703.text: "We're already offering to give up our entire share. So our ability to bargain is severely curtailed."

704.speaker: Elena Werner
704.text: "Either we strike demands from our list, or scrap this nationalization plan completely."

705.speaker: Elena Werner
705.text: "But the impact on our finances would be catastrophic. Not to mention our relationship with Rizian Royal Gold."

706.speaker: Elena Werner
706.text: "We've already offered to shrink our share. Our ability to bargain is severely curtailed."

707.speaker: Player_Romus
707.text: "I understand, but it's more important to me that our demands be met. I am willing to let Morella completely take over our MITZ share."

710.speaker: Elena Werner
710.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. At least the treasury will receive compensation for the assets we are losing."

711.speaker: Player_Romus
711.text: "You've made your point. I'm willing to revisit our list of demands."

712.speaker: Elena Werner
712.text: "And if Morella truly provides us with everything we are asking for, it may well be worth it."

714.speaker: Elena Werner
714.text: "Well, Mr. Esquibel? I assume you will relay these changes in the agreement to Morella at once?"

715.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
715.text: "And have no fear, Your Majesty. I trust your wisdom."

716.speaker: Elena Werner
716.text: "But who knows? If we play our cards right, this could be the coup of the century."

717.speaker: Elena Werner
717.text: "Yes, who knows? If we play our cards right, this could be the coup of the century."

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "Damn. All right, let's revisit the list of concessions."

730.speaker: Narrator
730.text: Elena nodded and raised her pen to take notes.

731.speaker: Narrator
731.text: Elena nodded and raised her pen to take notes.

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "I see. A 20 percent share it is, then."

734.speaker: Narrator
734.text: Elena scribbled a note in her ledger.

737.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
737.text: "Prime Minister Alvarez still will not be pleased, of course. But we have stopped short of outright angering him."

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "Tempting to you, perhaps. I've still got my heart set on a Trade Zone without Lespia, even if we don't take over their share."

739.speaker: Player_Romus
739.text: "I see your point. We will keep our current share, and the Lespians will keep theirs."

740.speaker: Player_Romus
740.text: "I'm not tempted. Let's revisit our list of concessions."

744.speaker: Player_Romus
744.text: "Forget it, Ms. Werner. I will not shrink Rizia's MITZ share, nor will I agree to additional concessions."

745.speaker: Player_Romus
745.text: "Damn. I see no choice but to agree to a smaller share."

748.speaker: Elena Werner
748.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. Rizia will cede majority control of the MITZ to Morella, and we will cancel all previous concessions we agreed on."

749.speaker: Narrator
749.text: She scribbled a note in her ledger.

751.speaker: Player_Romus
751.text: "That makes no sense. Let's revisit the list of concessions."

754.speaker: Elena Werner
754.text: "Mr. Esquibel, I assume you'll inform the Morellan ministry immediately?"
754.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) == false)

755.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
755.text: "Right away, Ms. Werner. They'll be overjoyed."

758.speaker: Elena Werner
758.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. We will not make any additional concessions, and we will ask that Morella take over Lespia's MITZ share in lieu of Rizia."

759.speaker: Narrator
759.text: She scribbled a note in her ledger.

760.speaker: Elena Werner
760.text: "Mr. Esquibel, I assume you'll inform the Morellan ministry immediately?"

764.speaker: Elena Werner
764.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. We will make the concessions we agreed on in exchange for keeping MITZ ownership as it is."

765.speaker: Narrator
765.text: We convened in the council chambers. My councilors greeted me with concern etched onto their faces.

766.speaker: Player_Romus
766.text: "A king doesn't need sleep, Mr. Esquibel. He spends every possible moment caring for his people."

768.speaker: Player_Romus
768.text: "I've slept wonderfully since my return. Telling Madame Prime Minister where she could shove her renegotiation agreement gave me incredible peace of mind."

769.speaker: Narrator
769.text: The two of them glanced at each other. Elena cleared her throat.

770.speaker: Elena Werner
770.text: "I'm... glad you feel that way, Your Majesty."

771.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
771.text: "I do hope you can rest more easily after today's meeting."

772.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
772.text: "I do admire your dedication to your people. But you must remember to care for yourself as well."

773.speaker: Elena Werner
773.text: "Remember the '20s, Laurento? We worked for weeks at a time, hopped up on coffee and Agardian amphetamines."

774.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
774.text: "Nasty drugs, those. It's a good thing His Majesty Valero banned them."

775.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
775.text: "I hear there's much stronger stuff on the market nowadays. I'm too old for it, myself."

782.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
782.text: "Your Majesty. I hope you're rested from your trip."

783.speaker: Player_Romus
783.text: "Terribly. I could've handled the Morella negotiations much better."

784.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
784.text: "I'm sure you did the best you could, Your Majesty."

785.speaker: Elena Werner
785.text: "And we still have options. Though satisfying all four MITZ partners is a pipe dream at this point."

786.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
786.text: "We have been going through the possible outcomes now that MITZ negotiations have reached a standstill."

787.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
787.text: "Given the recent unpleasantness between Rizia and Lespia, it is not guaranteed that Prime Minister Alvarez will side with us."

791.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
791.text: "I believe Lespia is prepared to stand together with Rizia in this fight."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "Shouldn't our common stance on the MITZ be enough?"

793.speaker: Player_Romus
793.text: "It's the least they can do. I sacrificed a lot to get into Alvarez's good graces."

795.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
795.text: "Currently, Rizia and Lespia are in favor of keeping the status quo, while Morella and Valgsland are demanding change."

796.speaker: Player_Romus
796.text: "An understatement, Mr. Esquibel. I find Alvarez repulsive."

797.speaker: Player_Romus
797.text: "That's not true. Neither of us want the commies to win."

798.speaker: Elena Werner
798.text: "You're not alone. But we have to deal with him."

800.speaker: Elena Werner
800.text: "We cannot rule out the possibility that Mr. Alvarez will make a favorable deal with Prime Minister Saltana behind our back."

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "I don't want Lespia's help. We can do this alone."

805.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
805.text: "Maintaining a presence in Morella may be part of Lespia's plan to fight communism, Your Majesty."

807.speaker: Elena Werner
807.text: "Quite unfortunate in this case, Your Majesty."

808.speaker: Elena Werner
808.text: "Most likely involving the gas from the Aureus field, to which Lespia controls the majority rights."

815.speaker: Elena Werner
815.text: "If Pales wins full control over the Aureus field, this will most likely involve a gas deal."
815.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true)

816.speaker: Elena Werner
816.text: "Luckily for us, Lespia doesn't have much to offer that will interest Prime Minister Saltana."
816.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false)

817.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
817.text: "We may have no choice but to work with Lespia, Your Majesty."

818.speaker: Elena Werner
818.text: "So I believe that Prime Minister Alvarez will reluctantly side with us."

819.speaker: Player_Romus
819.text: "In other words... I have to win that arbitration case."

825.speaker: Player_Romus
825.text: "What if Rizia is not prepared to stand together with Lespia?"

826.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
826.text: "Then we risk losing our share, and potentially our international standing."

827.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
827.text: "With Lespia and Rizia as a united front, the vote will be split 50-50. The regulation and ownership of the Meftiem basin will have to remain the same."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "We *gave* Lespia those rights. They can't stab us in the back like that."

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "That'd be just like Alvarez. The sneaky bastard."

831.speaker: Elena Werner
831.text: "He feels the same way about us, I'm sure."

832.speaker: Elena Werner
832.text: "It would be a big help, Your Majesty."

833.speaker: Player_Romus
833.text: "Something really must be done about that gas field."

835.speaker: Elena Werner
835.text: "Something like what, Your Majesty? We had our chance to claim it."

836.speaker: Player_Romus
836.text: "Prime Minister Saltana would never get into bed with the Reinharts."

837.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
837.text: "Morella needs energy badly enough to overlook old grudges, Your Majesty."

838.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
838.text: "If Morella and Lespia do end up presenting a united front, we will need Valgsland's help to oppose them."

839.speaker: Player_Romus
839.text: "Saltana's bark is worse than her bite. I'm not worried."

840.speaker: Player_Romus
840.text: "Very serious. We should be stepping up our anti-revolutionary efforts."

841.speaker: Player_Romus
841.text: "Internal security is not your concern, Mr. Esquibel. Please stick to foreign policy."

842.speaker: Player_Romus
842.text: "I couldn't tell. I was too thirsty."

843.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
843.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. I did not mean to overstep."

845.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
845.text: "You know better than I do, Your Majesty."

846.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
846.text: "Ah, the old Morellan sukhar trick. I should have warned you about that..."

847.speaker: Player_Romus
847.text: "Thank you both for your hard work and good advice."

849.speaker: Player_Romus
849.text: "I wish it had not come to this. But one way or another, we will find a way forward."

853.speaker: Player_Romus
853.text: "I sense your doubt, Laurento. Have faith in your king and the divine hand that is guiding him."

855.speaker: Elena Werner
855.text: "I agree, Your Majesty. We just have to be prepared for it to take a while."

856.speaker: Elena Werner
856.text: "It may take a while. But we will find a way out of this."

857.speaker: Elena Werner
857.text: "It's what we are here for, Your Majesty."

858.speaker: Elena Werner
858.text: "Barring any unexpected unpleasantness, we can expect both Morella and Valgsland to support this arrangement at the next board meeting. It'll be three against one."

859.speaker: Elena Werner
859.text: "Barring any unplanned hiccups, we can expect Morella to support this agreement at the next MITZ board meeting. But we still need one more country's support for a majority."

860.speaker: Elena Werner
860.text: "Chancellor Hegel has expressed his reluctance to support any non-nationalization plan that involves Lespia. So we will have to hope that he comes around."

861.speaker: Elena Werner
861.text: "As part of this deal, Ms. Saltana is asking for the immediate construction of a pipeline from Rizia to Morella. The energy partnership will come into full effect when it is complete."

862.speaker: Elena Werner
862.text: "If all goes well, it will be complete in time for the gas to start flowing once the new MITZ agreement is ratified."

863.speaker: Elena Werner
863.text: "On the bright side, if this deal comes to fruition, the Morellans will pay for the construction of an energy pipeline from our country to theirs. Effective immediately."

864.speaker: Elena Werner
864.text: "What's more, if this deal comes to fruition, the Morellans will pay for the construction of an energy pipeline from our country to theirs. Effective immediately."

877.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
877.text: "While we have you here, a word on Pales."

878.speaker: Elena Werner
878.text: "Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is finishing up work on the pipeline that will carry gas from the Aureus field to Rizia."

885.speaker: Elena Werner
885.text: "Once drilling begins next year, we can expect high returns, even factoring in the royalties we'll have to pay to Pales."

886.speaker: Elena Werner
886.text: "Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is finishing up work on the pipeline that will carry gas from our section of the Aureus field to Rizia."
886.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == false)

887.speaker: Elena Werner
887.text: "Because of the small area allocated to us and the royalties we have to pay to Lespia and Pales, we can't expect high returns. But it'll be something."

888.speaker: Elena Werner
888.text: "Right, yes. The arguments are still being presented in our arbitration case."
888.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == false) == false)

890.speaker: Elena Werner
890.text: "Of course, Lespia's support of Pales counts for a lot. But we've received a number of statements in our favor from neighbors and other AN members."

891.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
891.text: "Rumburg and the rest of GRACE, of course. And, surprisingly, Valgsland."

895.speaker: Player_Romus
895.text: "I knew our comrades could be counted on."

896.speaker: Player_Romus
896.text: "Valgsland's only supporting us out of self-interest. If Pales wins, its own islands' economic zones will be in danger."

898.speaker: Player_Romus
898.text: "Your people come through in a pinch, Ms. Werner."

899.speaker: Elena Werner
899.text: "Please, Your Majesty. I don't identify with what Valgsland has become."

901.speaker: Elena Werner
901.text: "We share a belief in the sanctity of economic zones. That's all I know."

902.speaker: Elena Werner
902.text: "Whatever his motivations, Valgsland's backing is extremely valuable."

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.text: "Say no more. I'll talk to Vina."

910.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
910.text: "There's one small snag. The Palesians are requesting that we send a diplomatic liaison to Castle Reinhart to oversee the last stages of the deal."

914.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
914.text: "Evidently, the fact that we backed out of our original deal has the Duke worried we'll get cold feet about this one, too."

918.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
918.text: "Evidently, our willingness to work with Morella on a nationalization plan got the Duke worried."

919.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
919.text: "Evidently, the Duke still has questions about Rizia's true intentions when it comes to his country."
919.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_BuyCancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HostileToPales"] == true)

923.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
923.text: "Everything has been running smoothly so far. I'm sure it's just a standard precaution."
923.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_BuyCancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HostileToPales"] == true) == false)

924.speaker: Player_Romus
924.text: "Knowing what we now know about Pales' possible involvement in the Zille bombing, I'm beginning to question this deal myself."

928.speaker: Elena Werner
928.text: "And for what it's worth, Pales has been nothing but cooperative during the preliminary construction process."

929.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
929.text: "It's wise to ask questions. But I must remind you that we still lack concrete evidence."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "I can't shake the feeling that Reinhart has *something* up his sleeve."

931.speaker: Elena Werner
931.text: "For what it's worth, Your Majesty, Pales has been nothing but cooperative during the preliminary construction process."

932.speaker: Player_Romus
932.text: "Our deal was with Lespia, wasn't it? Why is Pales the one asking for a liaison?"

936.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
936.text: "Pales still owns the field, Your Majesty. The deal will have to be ratified by all three countries."

937.speaker: Player_Romus
937.text: "I agreed to pay everything he was asking for. I think I've earned his trust."

938.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
938.text: "I know, Your Majesty. But this would only be for a short while."

939.speaker: Player_Romus
939.text: "A reasonable request. As long as it's not for too long."

940.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
940.text: "It should only be for a short while, Your Majesty."

941.speaker: Elena Werner
941.text: "Yes, even if Lespia and Rizia are sharing the rights, Pales will still be keeping a close eye on the extraction and export process."

942.speaker: Player_Romus
942.text: "Still, I would prefer not to send anyone."

946.speaker: Player_Romus
946.text: "Don't we already have a diplomatic envoy in Pales? Can we use them?"

947.speaker: Player_Romus
947.text: "I assume we'll be sending a diplomatic envoy, then?"

948.speaker: Player_Romus
948.text: "Will you be fulfilling the liaison role, Laurento?"

949.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
949.text: "We certainly could. But Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted that he would prefer the presence of a higher-level individual."

950.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
950.text: "We certainly could do so. But Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted that he would prefer the presence of a higher-level individual."

951.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
951.text: "Ha! No, I've got my hands full, I'm afraid. And I'm too old for the travel such a role entails."

952.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
952.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. But if you change your mind, Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted he would prefer the presence of a high-level individual."

953.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
953.text: "This seems like a mostly symbolic position, geared toward someone young, energetic and quick-witted."

954.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
954.text: "Someone who commands respect, but is able to leave the capital for a six-month stretch without it affecting government operations."

955.speaker: Narrator
955.text: He and Elena slowly turned to look at each other, realization dawning on their faces.

956.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
956.text: "And we do know the Duke enjoys the company of the fairer sex..."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "You want me to pimp out my daughter to Axel Reinhart?"

959.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
959.text: "I'm certain Her Highness would be a great help, Your Majesty. But it's up to you. And the princess, of course."

960.speaker: Elena Werner
960.text: "Nothing so vulgar, right, Laurento? The presence of the Princess at Castle Reinhart would force the Duke to be on his best behavior."

962.speaker: Elena Werner
962.text: "But I understand your hesitation. I'm sure a standard diplomatic envoy would be effective as well."

963.speaker: Player_Romus
963.text: "Hmm. I have been thinking that my daughter would benefit from spending time abroad."

965.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
965.text: "Are you sure, Your Majesty? I feel that Her Highness would be a great help."

966.speaker: Elena Werner
966.text: "I'm sure a standard diplomatic envoy would be just as effective, Laurento."

967.speaker: Elena Werner
967.text: "I did love to travel when I was her age. Boat rides excepted."

968.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
968.text: "I am certain Her Highness would be a great help, Your Majesty. But it's up to you. And the princess, of course."

969.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
969.text: "You don't have to make the decision right away. But the Palesians are expecting an answer soon."

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "I'll speak with Vina and let you know what she says."

971.speaker: Player_Romus
971.text: "I understand. I will get back to you soon with my decision."

975.speaker: Player_Romus
975.text: "I've already decided. We'll use our existing diplomatic envoy for the job."

976.speaker: Player_Romus
976.text: "I've already decided. We'll send a regular envoy." [-1 Budget]

980.speaker: Player_Romus
980.text: "Tell Pales that there will be no liaison."

984.speaker: Elena Werner
984.text: "I don't see the need for it, anyway. The deal is as good as done."

986.speaker: Elena Werner
986.text: "There shouldn't be much for them to do, anyway. The deal is as good as signed."

987.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
987.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. I'll give the order straight away."

989.speaker: Elena Werner
989.text: "We've gone long past our allotted time. Why don't we call it a day?"

990.speaker: Player_Romus
990.text: "An excellent suggestion as usual, Ms. Werner."

991.speaker: Player_Romus
991.text: "Gladly. I've had enough foreign policy talk for a lifetime."

992.speaker: Player_Romus
992.text: "I would happily keep working. But for your sake, let us adjourn."

993.speaker: Elena Werner
993.text: "Morella has little clout with the AN, but in combination with other factors, the support Ms. Saltana has promised could help tip the scales."

994.speaker: Elena Werner
994.text: "We certainly cannot count on Morella's support now. But they have little clout with the AN anyway."

995.speaker: Elena Werner
995.text: "If our agreement with Morella proceeds as planned, we may earn their support. Though our neighbor has little clout with the AN on its own."

999.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
999.text: "Unfortunately, I highly doubt President Smolak will be motivated to speak in our favor."

1000.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1000.text: "If President Smolak was serious about wanting to renew ties between our countries, he will speak in our favor."

1001.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1001.text: "As for Derdia, it appears highly unlikely that the committee will be hearing from Supreme Wiseman Azmal."

1005.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1005.text: "As for Derdia, Supreme Wiseman Azmal does not hate us, but nor does he have a reason to stick his neck out for us."

1006.speaker: Player_Romus
1006.text: "I understand. Thank you for the update."

1007.speaker: Player_Romus
1007.text: "Anything else we can do to sway the vote in our favor?"

1008.speaker: Player_Romus
1008.text: "And our naval efforts? Do those have an impact one way or another?"

1012.speaker: Player_Romus
1012.text: "Sounds like we've got this in the bag."

1014.speaker: Elena Werner
1014.text: "Not at this point, Your Majesty. There's not much we can do but wait for the results."

1015.speaker: Elena Werner
1015.text: "Difficult to say, Your Majesty. There's not much we can do but wait for the results."

1019.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1019.text: "To be honest, I was uncomfortable with supporting Su Omina in Zille from the start."

1020.speaker: Player_Romus
1020.text: "We need Zille back, Mr. Esquibel. At all costs."

1021.speaker: Player_Romus
1021.text: "I appreciate your feedback. But it's too late to back out now."

1022.speaker: Player_Romus
1022.text: "I've made my decision, Mr. Esquibel. I don't want to hear another word from you about this."

1023.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1023.text: "Of course the reclamation of our territory is of the utmost importance, but..."

1025.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1025.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. My lips are sealed."

1062.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1062.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true) == false

1095.speaker: Player_Romus
1095.text: "And why would Emmerich Hegel decide to help a monarchy?"

1096.speaker: Player_Romus
1096.text: "I don't make deals with communists, Laurento. I'd rather our finances take the hit."

1100.speaker: Elena Werner
1100.text: "Everyone has a price, Your Majesty. Even Valgslandian Socialists."

1101.speaker: Elena Werner
1101.text: "We may be left with no choice."

1102.speaker: Player_Romus
1102.text: "Hegel seemed receptive to dealing with us. Of course, that was before negotiations with Morella stalled out."

1103.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1103.text: "True. If he is willing to bargain, his price is much higher now."

1104.speaker: Player_Romus
1104.text: "Trust me, we have nothing to worry about. Lespia won't budge against Morella."

1106.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1106.text: "At any rate, all we can do at this point is wait. If I hear of any counter-deals being made, we will talk about our next steps."

1107.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1107.text: "The question is whether Morella will accept that. How serious did Saltana seem about her threat to send Malenyevist revolutionaries to Rizia?"

1108.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1108.text: "At any rate, all we can do at this point is wait and keep watch. I will inform you of any future developments."

1110.speaker: Player_Romus
1110.text: "I only agreed to nationalization to have leverage over Morella. If I can't, then I will fight with Lespia to keep the status quo."

1114.speaker: Elena Werner
1114.text: "Either we strike demands from our list, or give up renegotiation completely."

1115.speaker: Player_Romus
1115.text: "I refuse to make an unfair deal. I'd rather fight with Lespia to keep the status quo."

1116.speaker: Elena Werner
1116.text: "A respectable decision, Your Majesty. But I hope you're prepared for the fallout."

1118.speaker: Narrator
1118.text: Elena nodded. I saw worry in her eyes.

1122.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1122.text: "The question is whether Morella will accept that."
